verdict.rationale: Qdrant is a vector database, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question for it. A probe confirms Qdrant documents an official MCP server on its own documentation site, so an agent can connect to Qdrant through a first-party MCP server. The agent skills mentioned on GitHub are a separate feature and are not credited here. Missing for 10: details on the server's tools, transports and setup steps, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of connecting an agent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
